_: Verbatim Judge.me reviews for LGP02 Tracer Mallet. Real submissions only.
_complete: All 58, both widget pages. Mean is 4.7069 -> 4.71, matching the rating Shopify reports, so this is the whole set and the histogram is exact rather than sampled.
_note: Both 1-star reviews are 'no left-handed putter' complaints from 2024. LGP02 has shipped a left-hand variant since (LGP02-LH, 89 in stock), so the product answers them now — worth knowing before reading the histogram as a quality signal.
